timeline.summary: Premier Explosives cancelled a ₹18.90 Cr export order for defence explosives due to non-receipt of an export license from the Government of India.
Premier Explosives received a ₹350.23 Cr export order for defence products from an international client.
Premier Explosives received a ₹33.69 Cr export order for rocket motors to be delivered over 18 months.
India Ratings assigned IND A-/Stable to ₹70 Cr new bank facilities and affirmed IND A-/Stable on ₹327 Cr existing facilities for Premier Explosives.
Premier Explosives Limited’s Board, led by K. Jhansi Laxmi, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.50 per share (25% p.a.) on May 29, 2026, pending AGM approval.
Premier Explosives reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹89.21 Cr, up 20.4% YoY, and a record order book of ₹1,569 Cr.
Premier Explosives Limited uploaded Q4 FY26 earnings call recording on May 30, 2026, signed by K. Jhansi Laxmi and LAXMI KALAKOTA.
On its Q4FY26 call, Premier Explosives guided FY27 revenue to ₹600-700 Cr with 15-20% margins, against FY26 revenue of ₹388.3 Cr and a ₹1,569 Cr order book.
Premier Explosives submitted its yearly Regulation 31(4) disclosure confirming zero promoter share encumbrances for FY26.
